jobs.title: Patient Care Technician
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Join our team as a Patient Care Technician supporting patients with end-stage renal disease in an outpatient dialysis clinic. Deliver direct, hands-on care under RN supervision, ensuring safe and compassionate dialysis treatment. Ideal for individuals with a high school diploma or GED and a commitment to patient care.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Join our team as a Registered Nurse to deliver life-saving care to patients with end-stage renal disease or chronic kidney conditions. Provide direct patient care, monitor health, and collaborate with a supportive clinical team. Ideal for candidates with an RN license and an ADN, committed to compassionate, high-quality care.

jobs.title: Biomed Service Specialist– Field Technician
jobs.descriptionTeaser: Take on the role of Biomedical Services Specialist and help ensure our dialysis clinics run smoothly. You will maintain and repair electro-mechanical equipment, supporting daily operations. Ideal for candidates with hands-on technical experience or a trade background, strong communication skills, and a valid driver’s license.
